subject: reasoning
question: In a certain code language, ‘FELLOW’ is written as ‘NGHYQN’ and ‘PURPLE’ is written as ‘TWRGNR’. How will ‘SUPRISED’ be written in that language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d9cf57c4ec53b90de0be6d7758f6cabbb4baf219308788652573be8b1f098343.png] 

The logic followed here is :

For, ‘FELLOW’ is written as ‘NGHYQN’

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/456d5efa97e3edfc132c93b6354bf994df4eb14aee889a5436ef5664c1c43b83.png] 

For, ‘PURPLE’ is written as ‘TWRGNR’

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8b5da1e2a558cf473958ca62c66288b78b75ef6878e5b952c3076f5dca4a7674.png] 

Similarly, for 'SUPRISED'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/beff36b27468f1c336bab533282a81ed16dab3b435327fc98d5ac398d54092ad.png] 

So, 'SUPRISED' will be written as ‘TRWUFGUK’.

Hence, **'****TRWUFGUK**' is the correct answer.
